# improve shake all

Make `git shake all` stop reporting deletions that did not happen and stop trying to delete branches the remote no longer has. Against a Bitbucket remote:

```bash
$ git shake all
Извлечение из origin
error: unable to delete 'QDEV-596': remote ref does not exist
error: не удалось отправить некоторые ссылки в «bitbucket.org:qase/app.git»
remote branch origin/QDEV-596 was deleted
error: unable to delete 'ekorniushin': remote ref does not exist
...
```

(the Russian lines are "Fetching from origin" and "failed to push some refs"). `git shake all` lists merged remote-tracking branches and pushes `:<branch>` for each; here the remote-tracking refs were stale — the branches had already been deleted on the server — so every push failed, and the script printed "was deleted" anyway.

Expected: prune before listing so that only existing remote branches are candidates, and report a deletion only when the push succeeded.
